name: extonify/extonify-custom-emails-per-product
description: Send custom WooCommerce emails per product, either inserted into a native email or sent as a separate message.

scripts-descriptions.test: Run both suites as separate processes. The integration half is DESTRUCTIVE and guarded — see test:integration.
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Run the pure-logic suite. Safe: no WordPress, no database.
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: DESTRUCTIVE: drops the plugin tables and restores them EMPTY. Run it against the dedicated database created by bin/create-test-db.php, never the working one. Refuses unless EXTONIFY_WCEP_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE_TESTS=1, WP_ENVIRONMENT_TYPE is local|development, and the effective database is a test database. See docs/testing.md.
